condition: With a manually managed transaction (const trx = await knex.transaction()), await trx.commit() resolves instead of throwing when the COMMIT itself fails (e.g. deferred constraint violation in PostgreSQL), so the data is silently rolled back.
workaround: Use the callback form knex.transaction(async (trx) => { ... }) so commit errors reject the transaction promise, or await trx.executionPromise after commit.
